description: changelog prints the release notes the build embedded and exits 0 with stderr empty, or, in a binary built without relmap, fails closed with KDLITH-CHG001 (exit 1, stdout empty). No generate step runs (the entrypoint and crate keys the kind requires go unused); the one exercise step runs check.sh in the scratch copy, which judges the build path the run declares: KDLITH_FX_CHANGELOG=absent for a binary built without relmap, anything else for one built with it. With relmap the notes open with a release heading and carry the 0.1.0 release's heading, summary and paragraph exactly; the remaining bytes are relmap's rendering of the changelog records and are not pinned here
